paragraphs: R' Pinchas ben Levi. Mentioned at the end of halakhah 3 in Shekalim, chapter 2, according to the Bavli version.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ג is read contextually as end of halakhah 3, not “sum total.” The locator remains chapter 2 of Shekalim, without independent named-edition verification.
“According to the Bavli version” preserves לגרסת הבבלי. This does not assert a surviving separate Babylonian Talmud tractate Shekalim or resolve the exact edition. The abbreviated title remains R'.
